scenario: The ego vehicle rear-ends another vehicle that is traveling at constant speed on a straight road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward and collides with the rear of another vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward at a constant speed ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: Both vehicles are on a straight road, with the ego vehicle positioned behind and approaching the adversarial vehicle from the rear.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must approach the adversarial vehicle from behind at a higher speed, and the scenario terminates upon collision with the rear of the adversarial vehicle.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the white vehicle from third-person view; the red vehicle is the adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego is behind the adversarial. At midpoint, ego closes the gap. At ending, ego strikes the rear of the adversarial. 3. Evidence: The red vehicle appears from the left and maintains constant position relative to road; white vehicle's position shifts from right of frame to overlapping with red vehicle, confirming rear-end collision.
